_description: Long-only momentum: enter market on a wickless bullish signal candle (upper wick < 10% of range) confirmed by RVOL >= 1.5, a level breakout, and a bullish 4h context. Initial stop below the signal candle low, then a trailing ATR stop.

_cost_model: fee 0.1%/side + slippage 0.05%/side = 0.31% round-trip; exit is a trailing ATR stop (no fixed TP).
